title: OpenChamber brings persistent, multi-model coding agents into one workspace
friendlyTitle: OpenChamber puts several coding agents in one place
summary: OpenChamber is an open-source development environment that can keep agents working toward session goals, run a task across as many as five models, explain large diffs and move sessions between desktop, browser, mobile and VS Code. It runs on the OpenCode SDK and says project and session content remain on the user’s machine.
friendlySummary: OpenChamber is a free, open-source workspace for coding agents. It can keep a task running, compare several models and let you continue from a computer, browser or phone.
whyItMatters: Coding-agent competition is shifting from the model to the surrounding workflow: persistence, comparison, review and remote access. Developers can use a single interface to test several models, but should still review its relay, tunnel and local-access configuration before exposing a workspace remotely.
friendlyWhyItMatters: It can reduce app switching and make AI changes easier to review. Check the security settings before opening your coding workspace to the internet.
